Class CreateScenarioController

java.lang.Object
controller.CreateScenarioController
public class CreateScenarioController extends Object
This class handles operations related to creating and managing scenarios. It interacts with the ScenarioRepository to perform operations such as scenario creation and retrieving a list of all scenarios.

  • Method Details

    • createScenario

      public String createScenario(String name, Restrictions restrictions, Map map)
      Creates a new scenario with the specified name, restrictions, and map. If a scenario with the provided name already exists, it will return an error message. In the case of successful creation, a default budget will be assigned to the scenario.
      Parameters:
      name - The name of the new scenario. It must be unique.
      restrictions - The restrictions to be applied to the scenario, such as time, locomotive types, and events.
      map - The map object associated with the scenario.
      Returns:
      A string message indicating the result of the operation. If successful, it confirms the scenario creation. If an error occurs, an appropriate error message is returned.

    • getMapListDTO

      public List<MapDTO> getMapListDTO()
      Retrieves a list of all available maps as DTOs. This method converts the domain Map objects to MapDTO objects for presentation purposes.
      Returns:
      A list of MapDTO objects representing all available maps.

    • getScenarioList

      public List<Scenario> getScenarioList()
      Retrieves a list of all available scenarios from the repository. The scenarios represent configurations defined for specific use cases and include attributes such as name, restrictions, and associated map details.
      Returns:
      A List of Scenario objects representing all scenarios stored in the repository. The returned list is an immutable copy, ensuring that the underlying data remains unaltered.
